versions.content: Mode changes shall be notified to SW-Cs through the RTE mode ports when the mode change occurs. This specification assumes that the port name is currentMode and that the direct API of RTE will be used. Under these conditions mode changes signaled by invoking Rte_StatusType Rte_Switch_currentMode_currentMode( Rte_ModeType_EcuM_Mode mode) where mode is the new mode to be notified. The value range is specified by the previous requirement. The return value shall be ignored. A SW-C which wants to be notified of mode changes should require the mode switch interface EcuM_CurrentMode.
